Name: (CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Shed
Author: crystalinerose
Description:
[center][size=4][b]Cozy Rustic Shed [/b]is the latest entry to my modern rustic interior suite —  a lofted shed design that utilizes the latest renovations feature from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]Misc Map Actions Properties[/url] [/b]so you can individually customize each shed on the farm! Also comes with a more gradual upgrade (i.e. sheds can be upgraded twice instead of once), with proportional price and material cost adjustments![/size][/center]
[center][size=4][b][i]
(Please carefully read the mod description as this mod's features go beyond a simple shed interior revamp!)[/i][/b][/size]

[size=3]🌿 This mod is part of the [b]Cozy Rustic Interior[/b] revamp series! 🌿
Find the rest of the series: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30038]Farmhouse [/url]| [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30714]Kitchen[/url]﻿ | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30070]Cellar[/url] | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30170/]Greenhouse[/url]﻿﻿

🌿 Need matching [b]Cozy Rustic Furniture[/b]? [url=https://emojipedia.org/herb#:~:text=An%20herb%2C%20a%20plant%20used,with%20five%20or%20seven%20leaves.]🌿
[/url]Find them here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33316]Buildable Kitchen[/url]﻿ | [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33318]Bakery n' Cafe[/url][/size][/center]
[center]-[/center]
[center][/center]
[left][img]http://i.ibb.co.com/tYhckBZ/features.png[/img]
[/left]
[list]
[*][size=3][b]Multiple shed size presets: [/b]Cozy Rustic Shed comes with two shed size sets - [b]Standard [/b](comparable or slightly larger in space to the vanilla shed) and [b]Smaller [/b](for more relaxed gameplay).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]﻿[b]Native recolor support: [/b]Has recolor options to match [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14790]DaisyNiko's Earthy Interiors[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21085]Starblue Valley[/url]﻿[/b], [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6098]Rustic Country Town Interiors[/url]﻿ (Dark & Light)[/b] and the [b]Oak Saloon[/b] swatch from [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11597]Aster's Beam Mod[/url]﻿.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]Highly customizable: [/b]Many visual AND gameplay tweaks for every shed upgrade level. See the [b]Config Options [/b]section for more details.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3][b]MMAP renovation options: [/b]Using the [b]Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench, [/b]sheds that have been upgraded to the maximum level can further be modified with a cellar or greenhouse space. [b]Every individual shed can have its own renovations![/b][/size][/*]
[*][b]Built-in lighting: [/b]Every upgrade has built-in sconces and ceiling lights that automatically light up at night and during rainy weather.[/*]
[*][b](OPTIONAL!) Shed upgrades only cost money: [/b]Toggleable setting to make all shed upgrades (initial building included) to only cost money and no material requirements. Prices have been adjusted proportionally![/*]
[*][b](OPTIONAL!) Extra room for Smaller shed size: [/b]When the [b]Smaller [/b]shed size preset is chosen, you can enable this setting to add the extra room on the final shed upgrade. For when if you want a smaller space, but not [i]too [/i]small.[/*]
[*][size=3][b]Full i18n support for ease of translation into other languages.[/b][/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Qfc2pd7/mod-contents.png[/img][/size]

[b][size=4]Shed Basics[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]With this mod, [b]sheds have to be upgraded twice[/b] before they can be maxed out.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]The upgrades come in two size presets: [b]Standard [/b]and [b]Smaller. [/b]You can see the comparisons under the spoiler tag below (from left to right, initial size -> first upgrade -> second upgrade):[/size]
[spoiler][b][size=4]Smaller Shed Size[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0VMS4fb5/Shed-Size-Smaller.png[/img]
[b][size=4]
Standard Shed Size[/size][/b]
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Pz5Rjs9z/Shed-Size-Standard.png[/img][/spoiler]
[/*]
[*]You can choose for the shed upgrades and the initial building cost to [b]only cost money[/b] (honestly the part of the shed-building grind that I hated the most, so begone!).[/*]
[/list][b][size=4]Extra Room[/size][/b]

[list]
[*]After reaching the final upgrade, an extra room will be added to your shed interior.[/*]
[*]The extra room is, by default, only available on the [b]Standard [/b]shed size's upgrade 2. It can be made available for [b]Smaller [/b]shed size using an option in the config. [/*]
[*]There are (currently?) three types of extra rooms: [b]Standard [/b](default, non-renovated, all-purpose room), [b]Cellar [/b](can be used to place casks), and [b]Greenhouse [/b](has crop plots enough for standard Sprinklers and a panoramic background).[/*]
[*][b]Greenhouse [/b]upgrade is available from the start, but [b]Cellar [/b]is only available after unlocking casks (i.e. farmhouse upgrade 3).[/*]
[*]The extra room in every shed you've built can be individually modified using the [b]Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench. It is purchasable from the Carpenter's Shop for 15000G.[/b][/*]
[*]To use, place down the Builder's Bench in the shed you want to upgrade, then interact to open the renovation menu.[/*]
[/list][center][url=https://ibb.co.com/cXpsbWQV][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/yBMxhzq7/Builder-Bench.png[/img]
[/url](This is how the Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench looks like with the default Oak palette.)
[/center]
[center][/center]
[b][size=4]Other Renovations[/size][/b]

[list]
[*][size=3]The [b]Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench [/b]is also used to do other, more cosmetic renovations to your sheds, namely [b]converting the ladders into stairs[/b] and modifications to the [b]Greenhouse [/b]extra room's fountain.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Stair renovation [b]is only available if the 'Stairs Instead of Ladders' config is set to [i]false.[/i][/b][/size][/*]
[*]The fountain renovation is, obviously, [b]only available for sheds with a Greenhouse-type extra room.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][i][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/Lx0ybss/config-options.png[/img][/i][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Shed Recolor: [/b]Changes custom tilesheet color to match your interior recolor mod. [b]Auto [/b]option matches with [b]Cozy Rustic Farmhouse, [/b]if you have it installed. [b]WARNING: DO NOT set to Auto if CR Farmhouse is not installed.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Builder's Bench Color: [/b]Changes the color of Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench. Comes in the four vanilla furniture wood palettes and custom palettes found in the [b]Cozy Rustic Furniture [/b]series.[/*]
[*][b]Shed Size:[/b] Changes between a set of standard shed upgrade sizes (comparable to vanilla) and a smaller size. [b]WARNING: Changing this setting mid-game may remove applied renovations in ALL shed instances.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Shed Upgrades Only Cost Money: [/b]Changes all shed upgrades and initial building cost to only cost money (no material cost). Default [i]false.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Check for Renovation Obstructions:[/b] Check for obstructions before placing shed renovations. Default [i]true.[/i][/*]
[*][b]Extra Room for Smaller Shed:[/b] Toggles extra room presence when shed size is [b]Smaller[/b]. Default [i]false. [/i][b]WARNING: RESTART after changing this setting mid-game.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Shed Ladder Position: [/b]Toggles ladder position in shed upgrades that have ladders.[/*]
[*][b]Stairs Instead of Ladders:[/b] Changes ladder to stairs in shed upgrades that have ladders. Default [i]false. [/i][b]Setting this to [i]true [/i]will remove ability to individually renovate ladders in each shed into stairs using the Cozy Rustic Builder's Bench.[/b][/*]
[*][b]Greenhouse Room Panorama: [/b]Changes the panorama background in the Greenhouse-type extra room. Comes with [i]Forest [/i]and [i]Beach [/i]options to match [b]Cozy Rustic Farmhouse/Greenhouse.[/b][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/3NC8PLn/compatibility.png[/img][/size]

[size=3][b][u]Compatible[/u][/b][b] [/b]with the following mods that affect interior recolors: [b]VPR, Earthy Interiors, Starblue, Rustic Country Town Interior (Dark, Light)[/b].[/size]
[size=3][b][u]
Partially Compatible[/u][/b] with [b]Aster's Beam Mod[/b] for the following swatch: [b]OakSaloon. [/b]This matches the Vanilla 'Dark Oak' used in cellars and certain town interiors.[/size]

[size=3][u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with other mods that edit the vanilla Shed interior.[/size]
[size=3][u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with other mods that edit the vanilla Shed upgrade cost parameters.[/size]
[size=3][u][b]Not Compatible[/b][/u] with [b]TMXL Toolkit. [/b]I am NOT responsible for my mods 'breaking' because you continue to use severely outdated frameworks.[/size]

[size=3][b]THIS MOD IS NEITHER MADE FOR NOR TESTED ON MOBILE. [/b]I will not respond to any inquiries about mobile Stardew compatibility.[/size]

[size=3][b]I will not add recolor compatibility with mods other than the ones mentioned in the above section.[/b] If you want to add an unsupported recolor, contact me first. Uploading a recolor compatibility to this mod as a separate mod on Nexus or any other platform is strictly prohibited.

[b]If you want to submit an i18n translation,[/b] feel free to contact me on [b]Discord (@crystalinerose), [/b]DM me on Nexus Mods,[b] [/b]or post a link in the comments so I can add them to this mod.[/size]

[size=3]﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/0sYpYjq/installation.png[/img][/size]

[list=1]
[*][size=3]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url]﻿[/b] (not required, but recommended for dealing with voided items/items stuck in walls).[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Download and unzip [i]"(CR) Kisaa's Cozy Rustic Shed" [/i]archive into your SteamLibrary/common/Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/size][/*]
[*]Download the additional file [i]"FixIndoorItemMoves" [/i]and unzip into your Mods folder as well. [/*]
[*][size=3]﻿Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Have fun![/size][/*]
[/list]
[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/JRHCTRD/bugs-issues.png[/img][/size]

[list]
[*]The position of items placed in sheds after upgrading may be rather janky. Chu and I have tried to fix this to the best of our abilities, but you may end up with items stuck in walls or scrambled. The additional download [b]FixIndoorItemMoves [/b]can alleviate this issue, but because this is originally a vanilla bug, it may not work 100%. [b]My advice is to not invest in decorating sheds until they're fully upgraded.[/b][/*]
[*][size=3][b]When building the Extra Room renovation options[/b], there might be an obstruction error that prevents you from building the renovation even if there is nothing in the renovation area. To fix this, [b]set the Renovation Obstruction Check config option to false.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3]Sometimes the built-in light effects may not immediately apply. To fix this, [b]leave and reenter the shed.[/b][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][size=3]Not yet properly tested on multiplayer. Feel free to and report any multiplayer-related issues back to me, but I cannot guarantee I can fix them.[/size][/size][/*]
[/list][b][size=4]I only respond to bug reports that are properly submitted to the Bugs section and not in Posts. Do follow the directions listed in the pinned comment.[/size][/b]

[size=3][img]https://i.ibb.co.com/VVn4qL0/credits.png[/img][/size]
